# Openfield AI

> Openfield AI is an AI image and video generation studio.

## Main pages

- https://openfieldai.vercel.app/
- https://openfieldai.vercel.app/pricing
- https://openfieldai.vercel.app/mcp

## MCP

The Openfield MCP server endpoint is:

https://openfieldai.vercel.app/api/mcp

OAuth discovery metadata is available through the standard MCP well-known endpoints.

## Notes

- The /mcp page is documentation/setup information.
- The /api/mcp endpoint is the actual MCP server.
